ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio with approximately 92% low-intensity dark pixels across the primary surface and 8% high-intensity white pixels localized at the distal tips and surface scars.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-gray to black pigmentation across both fluke lobes. High-intensity white geometric clusters (barnacles) localized at the extreme left and right distal tips. Sparse light-gray circular and linear patches distributed across the interior ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A central V-shaped notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 90 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, sharp-peaked serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary, with pixel-amplitudes varying between 5 and 15 pixels from the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex trajectories extending from the median notch toward the distal tips along the trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white circular nodes located at both distal tips (barnacles). Multiple light-gray circular rosette-style scars visible on the central interior surfaces of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct light-gray linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) concentrated in the lower-mid regions of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the distal tips; various circular and linear scars/abrasions across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The trailing edge exhibits an exceptionally pronounced and consistent jagged serration pattern across both lobes.
